audit.summary: One Major issue in entropy numerical validation and six separately calibrated Minor scope/definition/proof-range/static-code corrections. Core conditional continuous-flow and intrinsic-metric statements not broadly refuted.
limitations: P1 — Entropy recipe is inconsistent and the outgoing-only derivative can violate the inverse operator domain — Counterevidence: Snapshot uses negative sign, so no claim actual displayed entropy figures used inward positive gradient. Core continuous theorem not disproved; no figure-generation provenance certified.

P2 — Inverse proposition needs a range condition and horizontal uniqueness — Counterevidence: Main theorem uses A=Sigma and compatible invariant gradient, so this is a scope correction, not a disproof of Theorem4.1.
P3 — Exact spectrum includes eigenvalues whose eigenspaces can be empty — Counterevidence: Main absolutely continuous flow case is not contradicted.
P4 — Metric derivative and reparametrization conventions are incomplete — Counterevidence: Actual construction uses full curve and can use corrected conventions; dynamic formula not refuted.
P5 — Mixed-mesh interpolation uses the wrong grid weight — Counterevidence: Proof calculations indicate local transcription repair; no counterexample to final Cauchy estimate.
P6 — Stated local-time range exceeds the range derived in the cited proposition — Counterevidence: No nonexistence claim; Section10.3 separately discusses concatenated global existence.
P7 — Pinned flow-matching plotting code mixes positions and model fields — Counterevidence: Static code finding only; no author code run, no proof that published images came from this exact snapshot.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: For epsilon1/5 and points(1,0),(0,2),(0,3), outgoing negative gradient sum=(-5/26,5/13), although surrogate is translation invariant. Moment [[-5/78,0],[5/39,-5/18]] nonsymmetric. Principal inverse residuals (0,5/182),(-5/91,0),(-15/182,0). Correct full incoming-plus-outgoing derivative has zero residual. True negative entropy scales -d log(a); printed positive surrogate scales +log(a).

Recorded check: A=Sigma=I,w=Sx, S nonzero skew: proposed v=Sx/4 but L(v)=0. Even w inI is insufficient for generalA: A=diag(1,2),Sigma=diag(1,3),W=[[0,1/3],[1,0]],B=[[0,1/8],[1/6,0]] not symmetric and residual [[0,1/12],[-1/12,0]]x.

Recorded check: d1,mu=delta1,uncenteredSigma1,L2dimension1: L=4, actualspec{4}, printed2(Lambda unionGamma)={2,4}.

Recorded check: rho_t=N(0,1+t) has IGW(rho_t+h,rho_t)=|h|, so denominator h has opposite one-sided limits. Constant alpha=N01,beta_t=N0,1+t,h=0 satisfy printed nondecreasing-map definition but lengths0and1.

Recorded check: tau1/2,eta1/4,s1/8 gives(1-ell_eta)+ell_tau=3/4, not1. Proofp26 uses ell_eta.

Recorded check: For c=lambda_minSigma0,E=F0-F*, theorem range is (1-1/sqrt2)c/(2^(5/4)E); Prop4.1 derives (1-1/sqrt2)^2 c^2/(2^(3/2)E). At c=E=1 ratio~4.06.

Recorded check: sample_velocity uses source_samples at every plot time; after loading W model global_velocities is not recomputed before drawing W contours/arrows.

repair.content:
Use coherent sign/normalization and full particle derivative or justify a different score estimator; enforce required horizontal/range condition and revisit affected experiments.

State w in L_A(I) and uniqueness inI, equivalently require symmetric Sylvester solution. For A=Sigma restrict w toI. In formal gradient derivation explicitly retain orthogonal invariance of F.

Add a nontrivial coordinate-orthogonal L2 complement/non-atomicity condition or qualify which branches occur.

Use |h| or h downarrow0; require continuous surjective endpoint-preserving nondecreasing reparametrization. Correct Eq54 local square/sum scaling consistent with L^2 bound.

Replace ell_tau(s) with ell_eta(s) in the eta interpolation and corresponding expansion.

Use derived range or supply additional uniform extension/estimates covering larger interval; handle E=0 separately.

Evaluate current trajectory samples and recompute model-specific grid velocities inside plotting routine.
